title: One-to-one deterministic assignment evaluator
description:
One deterministic evaluator performing one-to-one assignment between expected observations and findings, owning recall, classification, precision, negatives, unread and unscorable reporting.

Replaces the current any-match behaviour. `IDENTITY_ONLY_LAYERS` makes `findingMatchesCase` return true for data items with no span check, and `findMatchingFinding` uses `.find()` — first match wins, nothing is consumed. So one `data_item:email` finding satisfies every `data_item:email` gold case in the repository, in any file. With 436 data-item annotations and gold repeating keys within a packet, that is a direct recall inflator.

Assignment prefers exact canonical identity and stronger evidence matches. One finding cannot satisfy several gold cases; duplicate findings cannot all take credit from one case. Unmatched evaluable positives are false negatives; unmatched findings in closed scope are false positives.
